items.quote: Senden Sie uns die Stehlgutliste und die Kaufbelege bitte spätestens 10 Werktage nach dem Datum dieses Briefes;
items.computation: Letter is dated Monday 20.07.2026 and the period runs 'nach dem Datum dieses Briefes' (after the date of this letter), so under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the starting day (20.07.) is not counted; counting begins Tue 21.07.2026. The letter defines Werktage itself as Monday to Saturday excluding statutory public holidays. Counting Werktage from 21.07.: Tue21(1), Wed22(2), Thu23(3), Fri24(4), Sat25(5), Sun26 (skipped, not a Werktag), Mon27(6), Tue28(7), Wed29(8), Thu30(9), Fri31(10). No public holidays fall in NRW (or nationwide) in this window. The 10th Werktag is Friday 31.07.2026, itself a business day, so no further weekend/holiday roll-forward is needed.

warnings: A separate instruction to also hand the stolen-items list to the police is given with no deadline or date, so no due date could be set for it.
